text:
A small team and I are working on Sendery [1], a transactional email platform for product teams. We're trying to fix some of the headaches that come with managing product emails as companies scale: keeping track of hundreds of templates, maintaining consistent designs, coordinating changes between developers and marketing/ops, and managing everything across multiple languages is way more time consuming than it should be.

It's been a fun project to work on since it's been a pain point for myself on many projects, so I'm mostly just trying to solve my own set of problems and hoping other people find it useful too.

[1] https://sendery.co
